executor: Root only; this file has no UART executor

steps.name: preflight
steps.gate_before_next: Root requires new boot/taint0/CPU0/control0 and unused initial snapshot; no DMA yet.

steps.name: N2_A1_window
steps.original_command: printf "KERNEL="; uname -r; printf "BOOT="; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf "TAINT="; cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted; pre_seq=$(dmesg | sed -n 's/.*idma_batch_obs seq=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | tail -n 1); printf "PRE_SEQ=%s\n" "${pre_seq:-0}"; platform-timeout 120 idma_scaling --devices 2 --aggressor-pages 1 --timeout-ms 60000; case_rc=$?; printf "CASE_EXIT=%s\n" "$case_rc"; dmesg; printf "TAINT_AFTER="; cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted
steps.gate_before_next: Any timeout/nonzero/incomplete/parse or taint/STOP/drain/data error stops. Root validates saved original CLI result before normal post-read.

steps.name: N2_A1_post
steps.gate_before_next: Root inspects frozen counters/proc and accepts the low-pressure control before dispatching N4_A8; never auto-continue.

steps.gate_before_next: Any timeout/nonzero/incomplete/parse or taint/STOP/drain/data error stops. Root validates saved original CLI result before normal post-read.

recovery_proposals_not_automatic.name: freeze_once
recovery_proposals_not_automatic.command: [ "$(uname -r)" = "6.5.0-rc2-ispass2027-e2-timer-probe-v1" ] || exit 61; [ "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = "e96e8ccc-aa05-42ce-83f8-714b8a17060d" ] || exit 62; [ "$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online)" = "0" ] || exit 63; printf "0\n" > /sys/kernel/debug/riscv_timer_probe/control || exit 71; printf "RECOVERY_CONTROL="; cat /sys/kernel/debug/riscv_timer_probe/control || exit 72; printf "RECOVERY_TAINT="; cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted
recovery_proposals_not_automatic.condition: Only Root may decide to send after preserving timeout bytes and independently regaining a prompt. Freezing the probe does not stop or prove quiet DMA.
